name: closeout-readiness-check
description: Check one electrical closeout folder against a fixed, cited baseline for human review.
long_description: A private, read-only baseline check for one electrical construction closeout folder. Project files stay on the user's computer. Results require human review and never certify contract completeness or acceptance.

tools.name: check_closeout_folder
tools.description: Read one configured electrical closeout folder and return a cited baseline-readiness report for human review.

tools.name: manage_closeout_subscription
tools.description: Open the Stripe billing portal for the purchasing computer without reading the configured project folder.

tools.name: show_recovery_key
tools.description: Retrieve this subscription's recovery key from the purchasing computer for backup or activating another computer.

project_directory.title: Project folder
project_directory.description: Select the single electrical closeout folder this read-only check may access.

license_key.title: Recovery or company key (optional)
license_key.description: Optional only for another computer or support recovery. The purchasing computer activates automatically after payment.
